"≈ marks a deterministic proxy — a real measurement mapped to a CEFR band by fixed thresholds, not an AI opinion. Each band is a CEILING from one measurement (fast pace or long turns alone don't make a level), so the assessed level normally sits at or below the strongest bands here: the assessment also weighs error density and how far ideas actually get developed."
